purpose: Show that repeated Delta evaluations can be organized as a provisional field without collapsing into a metric space, topology, units, or physical field claims.

counterexample_case.label: Same ordinal pattern, different declared contexts
counterexample_case.setup: Trace T1 and Trace T2 both record LOW_MISMATCH -> MODERATE_MISMATCH -> HIGH_MISMATCH under repeated Delta evaluation. T1 uses Ctx_057_A with BDRY_057_A, while T2 uses Ctx_057_C with BDRY_057_C and a different declared residue-asymmetry parameter.
counterexample_case.result: The two traces can be organized as a provisional field while still failing to determine a scalar field, a vector field, a topology, an equal-interval structure, or a physical measurement.
